_comment: Example plan for a 2-layer STM32 + USB-C + 5V->3.3V buck board. Every number is a starting point the agent must justify (trace_width.py, stackup calculator, datasheets). Keys starting with _ are ignored.

stackup.notes: B.Cu = solid GND pour; F.Cu = components + signals

netclasses.name: USB_90R
netclasses._impedance_note: Width/gap are placeholders: get 90 ohm diff values from the fab's impedance calculator for YOUR stackup (1.6 mm 2-layer coplanar-with-ground usually needs a ground pour beside the pair).

custom_rules:
(rule "No vias in crystal area"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && A.intersectsCourtyard('Y1')")
  (constraint disallow via))
critical_order: 1. Buck hot loop: CIN -> U3 VIN/PGND on F.Cu, no vias; SW -> L1 short and wide
2. Decoupling: every 100nF to its MCU pin, GND via at the cap pad
3. Crystal Y1 + load caps: short, symmetric, guard by GND pour, nothing under it
4. USB D+/D- as a coupled pair from connector to MCU, ESD part in-line, no stubs
5. Feedback divider: tap VOUT at the output cap, route FB away from SW
